title: how the frozen Skill 89ae938a failed on the completed product-acceptance cycle
failure_mode: Sections 0-7 are a usable outline (freeze, layers, independent oracle, red-before-green, counterfactual, BLOCKED vs FAIL, real-boundary NO_GO). They were not enough for this cycle.

The candidate moved twice: handoff api.py 0016c55d -> e268c2b3; followup graph.py 801e8ae1 -> 340f188d. The Skill freeze is one-shot, so mixed-digest cards could still be treated as the current candidate.

Catalog rows were easy to close from a narrower slice: K05 host-500 and factor matrix; K11/K06 framework vs L4 ledger; C01/B01/I08/K01-sse proven-scope only. The Skill never separated parent row from slice.
Appendix REVIEW_PASS freeze conflicts with handbook 10.2 current-candidate regression. Historical originals must stay; current status must be allowed to become FAIL/INCOMPLETE.

Fresh-context verifier is a name plus Cursor Task pins. K04 actually needed: red on live 200+500, persist_response fix, live restart PID 37044 green, then a detached read-only review of original artifacts before claiming the slice. That sequence was not an executable Skill requirement. Review-before-ledger was already violated in the handoff pack.
L04 clicks completed while candidate_status stayed approved. Screenshot-is-not-enough did not force page/API/DB agreement.
Cost amount was unknown because provider fields were absent. The Skill asked for cost fields but did not make unknown recordable without becoming a pass.
Appendix continue-must-not-wait can outrank credential/production/isolation stops.

Appendix and leftover body names (env bootstrap file, data-dir variable, editor encoding, file URI workaround, vendor/model/launcher APIs, 109 passed) make the Skill this-repo/this-host. Independent review: reusable Skill FAIL.
skill-fix/check_skill.py plus false-green-skill-needles.txt is a substring GO. Independent review reproduced that dummy concatenation passes. That cannot evaluate this Skill.

skill-fix-2 (bd04be60) already tried a portable rewrite before product followup finished. User marked it ABANDONED_PREMATURE; Skill was restored to 89ae938a. That premature green is retained evidence, not this revision's oracle.
keep: 10.2-style NO_GO when P0/P1 or real boundaries are missing
must_become_executable_and_portable: re-freeze every phase and every product-source drift; product digest / Skill sha / review sha are separate
handbook row vs named slice; historical PASS/REVIEW_PASS originals stay; current candidate may FAIL/INCOMPLETE

L1-L5 including local-demo vs production and framework vs business ledger; unknown cost; safety stop outranks continue
isolation, credentials, executor, capture/test tools from project rules or run manifest
Skill eval by behavioral counterexample or independent review; substring checker is not GO
live defect: red -> owning-layer fix -> live restart green -> detached review; Skill revision is not product GO
